verdict.rationale: Jev is an AI model API that answers typed questions about state, so MCP-client tool use is a fair axis for it. The evidence never says Jev can connect to or call tools from external MCP servers. The agent skill (jev-docs-13, jev-docs-28) works the other way round: it gives coding agents like Claude Code context on the TypeSafe API, which is adjacent material and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
